# Japan travel and transport style

Base style: [OpenFreeMap Liberty](https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty), obtained 2026-10-28. See [OpenFreeMap styles](https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles) and `LICENSE.md`.

The customized style removes terrain shading, buildings, 3D extrusions, one-way arrows, minor street names and dense service paths. It emphasizes railways, stations, airports, major roads, cities, parks and visitor attractions. Japanese/native labels are preferred. This is a travel map, not a traffic congestion or route planning service.

The vector data, fonts and sprites are requested from `tiles.openfreemap.org`. No Google Maps, Google APIs, Google Fonts service, or GSI topographic tiles are used. Detailed online coverage depends on the provider's OpenStreetMap data and the visitor's network connection. The local overview remains available when these requests fail.

Required map credit: [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org/), [OpenMapTiles](https://openmaptiles.org/), [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Usage: https://openfreemap.org/quick_start/ . OSM data is under ODbL; style licenses are included in `LICENSE.md`.
